name: Forsion Video Studio
author: Forsion
description: AI 辅助的网页动画视频编辑器，也能做基础剪辑。视频就是一份 .fvs.md 工程文件：场景是网页，时间线踩在音乐的拍子上；图片和视频素材可以直接拖进时间线，分割、修剪、调整顺序、加转场，还有字幕轨。可以手动改文字和时间线，让 AI 导演写场景、配乐和检查卡点，再导出网页视频或 MP4。
descriptionEn: An AI-assisted editor for videos made of animated web pages, with the basics of clip editing. A video is one .fvs.md project file: scenes are web pages and the timeline sits on the music's beat grid; drop pictures and video clips onto the timeline, then split, trim, reorder, add transitions and captions. Edit text and timing by hand, have the AI Director write scenes, score the video and check the sync, then export a web video or an MP4.

onboarding.intro: 打开或新建一个 .fvs.md 工程就能编辑和导出网页视频。导出 MP4 和 AI 配乐由内置的「Video Studio 导演」Agent 在本机完成，需要 Chrome 或 Edge、ffmpeg；配乐还需要 Python。

steps.title: 新建工程
steps.description: 文件树右键「新建视频工程」，或命令面板「Video Studio：新建视频工程」。想先看看，可以运行「Video Studio：打开示例 · 第 2.12 话」。

steps.title: 搭场景、放素材
steps.description: 时间线工具条的「新场景」从模板里挑版式；「导入素材」或直接把图片、视频、音乐拖进时间线。双击画面里的文字直接改。

steps.title: 剪辑
steps.description: S 在播放头处分割，拖片段两端修剪，拖片段本身调整顺序，属性面板里加转场。相邻场景会让位，后面的切点不动；按住 Alt 则推移后面所有场景。双击时间线最上面的字幕轨加字幕，也能导入 SRT。

steps.title: 交给 AI 导演，然后导出
steps.description: 「AI 导演」写新场景、改节奏、配乐和检查卡点，它直接改这份文件，编辑器会自动载入。「导出」可以立刻写出网页视频，或由导演在本机渲染 MP4。

en.intro: Open or create a .fvs.md project to edit and export web videos. MP4 export and AI scoring run on this computer through the bundled Video Studio Director agent, which needs Chrome or Edge and ffmpeg; scoring also needs Python.

steps.title: Create a project
steps.description: Right-click in the file tree and choose New video project, or run "Video Studio: New video project" from the command palette. To look around first, run "Video Studio: Open the 2.12 example".

steps.title: Build scenes and add media
steps.description: New scene on the timeline toolbar offers ready-made layouts; Import media, or drag pictures, video and music onto the timeline. Double-click text in the picture to change it.

steps.title: Edit
steps.description: Press S to split at the playhead, drag a clip's ends to trim it, drag the clip itself to reorder, and add transitions in Properties. The neighbouring scene gives way so later cuts stay put; hold Alt to push everything after it. Double-click the captions track at the top of the timeline to add captions, or import an SRT file.

steps.title: Hand it to the AI Director, then export
steps.description: The AI Director writes scenes, changes the pacing, scores the video and checks the sync by editing this file; the editor reloads its changes. Export writes a web video at once, or has the Director render an MP4 on this computer.
